name: Algarve, Portugal

visa.notes: D7 visa requires proof of passive income. NHR ended Jan 2024; IFICI replacement excludes pensions; standard progressive rates 14.5%-48%.

rent.notes: Faro district asking rents averaged 17.50 EUR/m2/month in Aug 2026 (Doutor Financas observatory, listing based); a 80-100 m2 pet-friendly T2/T3 implies roughly 1,400-1,750. Idealista municipal medians (Mar 2025) ranged 12-17 EUR/m2 with Loule/Albufeira/Lagos highest, Olhao/VRSA/Portimao lowest; min reflects inland or eastern Algarve, max coastal Loule/Lagos houses.

groceries.notes: Two adults at 220-350 EUR per person per month (Lisbon-based 2026 guide; Algarve food prices are similar to Lisbon) plus about 85-95 EUR/month of large-breed kibble for a 100 lb dog (Royal Canin Maxi Adult 15 kg listed at 82-104 EUR, roughly 13-14 kg/month). Food CPI running 3.7% y/y (Oct 2026).

utilities.notes: Electricity ~65-80 (regulated-market couple at 3.45 kVA/1,900 kWh pays 37.77/month from Oct 2026; a 2-3BR house with summer A/C and some electric heating runs roughly double), bottled/piped gas ~25-30 (unverified estimate), water+sanitation+waste ~35-47 for 10 m3 (ERSAR 2026: national average 34.65; Loule 47.18, VRSA 47.39; Faro among the most expensive district capitals). Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: Legal residents register with the SNS at no premium (primary care free since 2022). Private top-up cover that expat retirees typically carry: a couple in their 60s on standard Medis/Multicare/Fidelidade plans pays about 250-350 EUR/month total (Sep 2026 guide); hospital-only plans for two are around 120; premium tiers 180-280 per person. Premiums rose ~10% in 2026.

insurance.notes: Re-modeled from old template (stored 130 was health cover; health cost now fully in healthcare). Tenant contents (recheio) policy for 30k EUR incl. seismic cover costs 40-73 EUR/year in Faro per DECO Sep 2026 test (Allianz Casa Base 39.68, ok! casa Completo 72.82); max allows tenant-liability add-on.

sources.title: Melhor seguro casa para inquilinos (DECO Proteste, 11 Sep 2026)

petCare.notes: Routine vet consults 30-45 EUR, annual vaccines 25-50 EUR (2026 guide; average dog upkeep 1,021 EUR/yr all-in), plus flea/tick/heartworm preventives dosed for a 100 lb dog (~35-45/month) and one extra visit or bloodwork a year. Food excluded.

sources.title: Animais de estimacao em Portugal: guia completo 2026 (Ricavida)

petDaycare.notes: Daycare/boarding quotes in the Lisbon area run 15-25 EUR per day (Fixando Q3 2026 median 20); occasional use of ~6-8 days a month or one boarding week a quarter gives ~150. Algarve-specific rates not separately verified; fewer commercial options outside Faro/Loule/Lagos.

sources.title: Preco de hotel e creche para animais em Cascais (Fixando)

petGrooming.notes: Bath and grooming quotes average 38-43 EUR (range 30-60) in the Lisbon market; a large double-coated dog sits at the top of that range, groomed every 6-8 weeks with home brushing in between.

sources.title: Preco de banhos e tosquias para animais em Lisboa (Fixando)

transportation.notes: Car-dependent region: one small car, ~800 km/month at 7 L/100 km with gasoline 95 at 2.03 EUR/L (1 Nov 2026) ~115, insurance ~29 (national average 344 EUR/yr, Mar 2026), maintenance/tyres ~40, IUC road tax ~15. Regional Passe Algarve (Vamus) is 40 EUR/month per person as an alternative; no senior discount found.

entertainment.notes: 1 Gbps fibre 15-35 EUR (Digi/UZO/WOO 10-15, MEO 29.99, Vodafone 31, NOS 35, Jul 2026), streaming ~30, dining out for two 3-4 times a month at ~55 EUR mid-range (Numbeo Lisbon Nov 2026; Algarve similar), plus cinema (8.50) and activities.

clothing.notes: Modeled basket for two retirees from Numbeo Nov 2026 item prices (jeans 92, chain-store dress 40, running shoes 92, men's leather shoes 108): a few mid-range items per person per quarter.

sources.title: Cost of Living in Lisbon, Nov 2026 (Numbeo)

phoneCell.notes: Two local lines: low-cost brands (Digi, UZO, WOO, Amigo) 5-7 EUR each for 100 GB/unlimited; main brands MEO/NOS/Vodafone 13-20 EUR unlimited (Jul 2026). Typical assumes two main-brand plans; max allows keeping one US number (e.g. Google Fi) alongside.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: SNS taxas moderadoras now apply only to unreferred hospital emergencies; primary care, scheduled consultations and exams are free. Out-of-pocket is mainly private-side: GP 50-100, specialist 80-180, dental check 40-90, blood panel 60-150 (2026), reduced to 15-25 EUR copays when using insurer networks; interior/Algarve 15-30% below Lisbon.

sources.title: Vai as urgencias sem passar pelo SNS 24 - taxas moderadoras (Postal, Aug 2026)
The Real Cost of Private Healthcare in Portugal 2026 (Portugal Brief)

healthcare.system: SNS (Serviço Nacional de Saúde) - public universal healthcare with private option. Residents access public system via health center registration.
healthcare.waitTimes: Moderate for specialists (2-6 weeks), shorter in Algarve due to lower population density
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Public system covers most prescriptions with co-pays of 0-90% depending on category

stateIncomeTax.exemptions: NHR ended Jan 2024 (IFICI replacement excludes pensions). Foreign pensions/retirement income taxed at standard progressive rates 12.5-48%. US-Portugal treaty provides foreign tax credit.

taxes.notes: NHR ended Jan 2024. IFICI replacement excludes pensions. Standard progressive rates 14.5%-48%. US-Portugal tax treaty helps avoid double taxation.
